R0177.title: Immutable Contract Design Flaws
R0177.definition: Smart contracts cannot be modified or upgraded after deployment; design flaws or vulnerabilities will exist permanently, creating long-term risks.
R0177.description: After deployment, blockchain smart-contract state changes are constrained by on-chain rules. When a contract lacks upgrade, pause, migration, or emergency-response paths, serious vulnerabilities or business-logic errors often cannot be fixed in place and the contract must be abandoned and redeployed. This can leave faulty logic affecting the business for a long time, slow protocol adaptation, and increase later migration and user-coordination costs. Even proxy-based upgrade designs need clear authorization boundaries, audit checks, and governance workflows so the repair path does not weaken the original security assumptions.
R0177.influence: Contract vulnerabilities cannot be fixed, funds permanently locked, business cannot iterate and optimize.
